title: Setup: {view}
tripod.title: Put the tripod here
tripod.body: Place the tripod as shown, lens pointing at the ball. The numbers are worked out for this venue.
tripod.diagram: Top-down view of the tripod position, {view}
tripod.height_hint: From the mat to the centre of the lens
tripod.no_bay: No bay depth measured: using the standard distance. Add the bay depth to the venue for better numbers.
view.label: Camera angle
view.changed: Switched to {view}: phone {orient}, set up again from step 1
level.title: Level the phone
level.body: Turn the tripod head until the bubble sits in the middle circle. It moves on by itself after 1 second of green.
level.roll_pos: The phone tilts right: turn it a little to the left
level.roll_neg: The phone tilts left: turn it a little to the right
level.pitch_pos: The lens points up: tip it down a little
level.pitch_neg: The lens points down: tip it up a little
level.reason: Get the bubble to the middle first
level.denied_body: You can continue without it; the angle is then worked out from the mat only, which is a little less accurate.
level.none_title: This device has no level sensor
level.none_body: The angle is worked out from the mat. Lining up with the dashed frame is enough.
level.still_off: The level is still off: the angle comes from the mat
corners.title: Line up the mat
corners.body: Move the tripod until the mat sits in the dashed frame, then tap the four mat corners.
corners.picking_body: Tap the 4 corners in order; the loupe shows the detail. Fine-tune with the arrows below.
corners.no_frame: The camera picture is not ready yet; wait a moment
corners.no_solve: Could not work out the phone position: check the corner order (start at the corner behind you, phone side)
corners.flock_running: Calibrating the lens: {n} of {total}, keep the phone still
corners.flock_failed: The lens is not calibrated yet: you can continue, or tap the corners once more for better numbers
corner.1: Corner toward the target, phone side
corner.2: Corner toward the target, far side
picker.canvas: Mat picture: tap the four corners
ball.title: Place the ball
ball.body: Put the ball on its usual spot and tap “Find the ball” to check the camera sees it.
ball.not_found: No ball where we expected it: put the ball on the mat spot and try again
ball.no_predict: We do not know where the ball should be yet: line up the mat first
address.title: Stand at address
address.body: Take your club, stand at the ball in your address position, and check your whole body is inside the frame.
done.title: Setup complete
done.green_body: Everything lines up. Walk back to address and start hitting.
done.amber_title: You can start, with a note
done.warn_no_level: No level: the angle comes from the mat
done.back_corners: Go back and line up the mat
done.no_calib_title: The mat is not lined up yet
done.no_calib_body: Go back to step 3 and tap the mat corners.
done.force_body: Ball numbers this session will be marked low confidence. Tempo is not affected.
done.forced_toast: Started: ball numbers this session are marked low confidence
fix.rotate_ccw: The phone is tilted: rotate it back anticlockwise (about {deg}°)
fix.rotate_cw: The phone is tilted: rotate it back clockwise (about {deg}°)
fix.move_closer: Move the tripod {dist} closer to the ball
fix.move_left: Standing behind the phone, move the tripod {dist} left
fix.move_right: Standing behind the phone, move the tripod {dist} right
fix.frame_mat: The mat is too close to the edge: move the tripod back so the whole mat is inside the frame
fix.retap: The corners are not precise enough: tap them again with the loupe
fix.lens_1x: The lens looks different: make sure it is the 1× lens with no zoom
fix.align_ghost: The mat is off the dashed frame: move the tripod so the corners meet the circles
fix.ball_again: The ball size looks wrong: check it sits on the mat spot and find it again
fix.preset_view: This camera spot is for another angle: set up again
fix.frames_budget: The ball crosses the picture quickly: fast swings may miss ball numbers
fix.generic: Not lined up yet: tap the mat corners again
mic_off.title: Microphone is off
mic_off.body: The strike cannot be heard: swings are detected from motion, so a practice swing may count as a shot.
sun.title: Bright sun?
sun.body: Switch to the Sun display: high contrast and bolder text, easier to read outdoors.
clip.title: Slow-motion mode: record a short calibration clip
clip.s1: Once the frame and level are right, tap “Hand the camera to the Camera app”.
clip.s2: Record 2 seconds of the empty mat in slow motion with the iPhone Camera (240 fps, 1×).
clip.s3: Come back and pick that clip from Files.
clip.release: Hand the camera to the Camera app
clip.no_decoder: This browser cannot read the video
clip.decode_failed: Could not read the clip: record it again
clip.too_short: The clip is too short: it needs 2 seconds
clip.refine_failed: The corners are unclear: tap them more precisely with the loupe
clip.drift: The mat moved {px} px between frames: the tripod shook, record again
dev.title: Developer details
dev.light_none: No locked frame to compare yet
dev.light_changed: Light changed {pct}%: the background is rebuilt
